meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Applies Arbor Hypothesis Tree Refinement to research artifacts with repeatable evaluators, including model training, agent harnesses, data synthesis and benchmark optimization. Uses persistent hypotheses, isolated experiments, evidence propagation and held-out candidate comparison for multi-experiment research runs. Includes a standard-library state manager and guidance for the RUC-NLPIR Arbor CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织多轮模型实验,让每个假设都有证据、可对比
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在反复训练模型或跑基准测试,却理不清每轮实验的来龙去脉
copy.tagline_en: Turn repeated model experiments into reproducible, comparable hypothesis runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep retraining models or running benchmarks and lose track of each run

howto.what: Claude 会围绕你已有的产物(代码、训练配方、提示词等)建一棵持久假设树:派子代理在隔离 git worktree 里逐个跑实验,记录并向上归纳证据;只有通过留出测试评估的改动才并入最优版本,最后给出报告和可运行产物。
howto.when: 当你要在多轮实验中迭代改进一个有明确评分方式的产物(模型训练、agent 框架、数据流程等),或你描述反复「实验—评估」循环、分支探索多个想法、担心 dev/test 差距时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个模型的评测分数提上去
say.note: 它会先和你确认目标、dev 评估器和留出测试评估器。

say.text: 用 Arbor 优化这个 agent 的通过率,别只在 dev 上调
say.note: 搜索用 dev 打分,并入前必须过测试门槛。

say.text: 给我看假设树状态和最优产物所在分支
say.note: 输出审计轨迹,并告诉你怎么检出产物。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps a persistent hypothesis tree for your artifact: subagents test one hypothesis each in isolated git worktrees, lessons are abstracted upward, and only changes passing a held-out test evaluator merge into the best version.
howto.when_en: Use it when iteratively improving an artifact that has an objective and a scoring method, or when the user describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration, or a dev/test gap.

say_en.note: It first pins down the objective and the dev/test evaluators.

say_en.text: Use Arbor to improve this agent's pass rate, without overfitting dev
say_en.note: Dev scores steer search; the test gate admits changes.

say_en.text: Show me the hypothesis tree status and the best artifact's branch
say_en.note: It prints the audit trail and how to check the artifact out.
